title: GenuinePurity Quercetin Review 2026: Benefits, Dose, Truth (New Report)
abstract: On balance, the product is a reasonable choice for adults looking for a clean, well-formulated liposomal quercetin - particularly for daily antioxidant support and for people thinking about seasonal allergy and histamine response - and less of a fit for buyers expecting clinical-grade senolytic outcomes, same-week results, or anything that would substitute for prescribed medication. *Are starting to notice seasonal allergy symptoms and want to try a clean, well-formulated quercetin product for mast-cell support.* The 500mg daily dose matches allergy research recommendations, the liposomal delivery is a plausible absorption improvement, and the 97-day guarantee gives enough time to run a full pollen-season trial. **What it is:** a reasonably-priced, cleanly-formulated liposomal quercetin supplement from an established company with a generous return policy, positioned best for daily antioxidant and inflammation support and particularly well-suited for seasonal allergy and histamine support at its specific dose.
